claims: Carlos Boozer has twin sons named Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born in 2007.
Duke University is Carlos Boozer's alma mater.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to Duke University in October 2024.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are class of 2025 recruits.
Carlos Boozer is a former Duke and NBA star.
Cameron Boozer is a power forward.
Cameron Boozer has won gold medals with USA Basketball.
Cameron Boozer was named the 2023 Gatorade National Boys Basketball Player of the Year.
Cayden Boozer is a point guard.
Carlos Boozer has an older son named Carmani.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born through IVF screening to be a perfect match for their older brother Carmani.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer provided a stem cell transplant that saved Carmani's life
